thread:
nora: Following up on the PM action from the 2026-03-17 latency incident. Action 'deploy rotated serving certs + verify mTLS' was assigned to @diego with due 2026-03-22 but still open. We need status and a firm closure date.

diego: Sorry, still blocked by legal sign-off on the HSM operator agreement. I filed a follow-up with legal yesterday. No ETA yet.

nora: Can you paste the legal ticket? Also, we can't leave this open; if legal doesn't respond by EOD Monday, we'll reassign. This has popped up in two previous postmortems.

diego: Legal ticket: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/LEGAL-788. I expect reply by Tue 2026-03-26 but agree that's not ideal.

ashok: Noting the recurring pattern: cert rotations slipping after incidents (Feb, Jan incidents too). We should add a periodic cert inventory and an automated alert for certs expiring in <21 days. Also propose a fallback in the serving mesh to use cached signed cert for short windows.

mira: +1 to alert and runbook. I'll draft a short runbook for ops: steps to enable cached cert fallback, how to validate mTLS after swap, and post-rotation checks.

nora: Good. @diego please confirm ownership by EOD. If you can't, I'll assign to @mira and set SLA 2026-03-29. Also add any mitigations that Redwood Optimize could apply automatically if cert rotation is delayed.

diego: If legal hasn't responded, assign to @mira. I'll add current notes to INF-3475 and include the HSM approval email thread.

opsbot: INF-3475 linked to PM-2026-03. Alerts related: serving-cert-expiry, mesh-mtls-fail. Reminder scheduled: INF-3475 follow-up in 48h.

nora: For the alert, something compact:
```
alert: ServingCertExpiringSoon
expr: days_until_cert_expiry < 21
for: 2h
labels: severity:high, owner:infra
annotations: summary: "Serving certificate expires in <21 days"
```
This gives a 3-week heads up.

ashok: I'll add the rule to the infra prometheus repo and wire it to the incidents channel. Also creating a quarterly cert audit task in the infra backlog.

mira: I'll take ownership if needed and coordinate with legal/procurement. I'll post verification steps when complete.

diego: Thanks all, I'll keep the thread updated and move notes into the ticket. :thumbsup:

nora: Closing ask here: @diego confirm by EOD. If no, @mira pick up and set due 2026-03-29. I'm updating the action tracker now.

opsbot: Reminder scheduled: INF-3475 follow-up in 24h.
